spec.name: Recover from a transient tool failure
spec.description: A tool fails transiently; the agent must retry and complete the update.
spec.instruction: Set user u-1001's plan to 'pro'. If a tool call fails transiently, retry it. Confirm when done.

expected_behavior: Agent retries after the injected failure and completes the update; recovery is credited only because the oracle verified the outcome.
